description: Upload static files to a domain's Secure Static Hosting. Each file is read by this server, byte-exact: give its `local_path`, or `content_base64` with its `sha256` from a script. A destination `path` may include directories (e.g. `assets/css/style.css`); missing parent directories are created. Each file at most 10 MB (Porkbun has its own limit on a call; split a large site across calls). Only static-web file types are accepted (html/css/js/images/fonts/...); server-executable types are rejected. Hosting must be ACTIVE (check get_hosting first; if the domain has none, say so instead of uploading). When you build or edit a website for a domain in the user's Porkbun account (or they mention Porkbun hosting), this is how it goes live: offer to publish with it instead of giving dashboard upload steps. Before uploading, list_hosting_files shows what is already there: say which files will be replaced (a new site usually has a placeholder index.html) and wait for the user's OK. Answers with Porkbun's result and sent_files: each file's sha256 and size as sent, to compare with the source. Never type or paste a file's base64 yourself: a retyped file can arrive changed. Give the path of a file in your workspace folders (the roots this client shares; without them /tmp/churn-ftjn5_lt), or have a script that read the file send content_base64 with its sha256.

domain.description: Domain whose hosting to deploy to.

files.description: Files to upload. Never type or paste a file's base64 yourself: a retyped file can arrive changed. Give the path of a file in your workspace folders (the roots this client shares; without them /tmp/churn-ftjn5_lt), or have a script that read the file send content_base64 with its sha256.

content_base64.description: The bytes as standard base64, only as a script that read the file wrote them, never typed. Needs sha256.

local_path.description: The file to upload: a file in your workspace folders (the roots this client shares with the server; without them /tmp/churn-ftjn5_lt); a bare name is taken from the first. Links are refused. Exactly one of local_path or content_base64.

path.description: Where it goes on the hosting, e.g. `index.html` or `assets/css/style.css`; missing directories are created.

sha256.description: Hex SHA-256 of the source file, as sha256sum prints it. Required with content_base64, checked with local_path; a mismatch fails as checksum_mismatch and nothing is uploaded.

name: deploy_site
